VICR.headline: Why Vicor Stock Was Crushing it This Week
VICR.description: Vicor, a power components supplier for AI deployments, surged nearly 24% this week after raising Q3 revenue growth guidance from ~10% to over 20% sequentially. The increase is driven by royalties from non-exclusive licenses of its vertical power delivery (VPD) technology granted to four leading OEMs and hyperscalers, with high-margin licensing revenue boosting growth.
